Follow the evidence

Review supporting records, competing explanations and missing evidence in one place.

Observation

Feed delivery decreased at hour 18.

Historian · DEMO-104 / FEED-01 · synthetic record

Hypothesis

Pump tubing wear could explain lower delivery.

Maintenance note · DEMO-WO-204 · synthetic record

Counterevidence

No corresponding dissolved oxygen sensor alert.

Instrument log · DEMO-DO-02 · synthetic record

Missing evidence

Pump inspection and gravimetric calibration.

Requested · not yet available · synthetic record

What happens next

Request the pump inspection record to test the leading hypothesis.

Proposal
Inspect feed pump tubing and verify delivery against calibration.
Rationale
The sample feed trace and maintenance note support checking the pump; a cause is not confirmed.
Owner
Demo process engineer
Status

Outcome to check
Compare calibrated delivery with the reference range after an authorized inspection.

What happens next
